The Bingham High School band was invited to the Pearl Harbor Parade to represent the State of Utah. They will also represent USS Utah, one of the two wrecks that are still at Pearl Harbor.
The USS Utah was one of the first ships hit by Japan. What happened at Pearl Harbor changed all of our lives, and this trip will change the children's lives, too.
"So we have a little bit of time built in, and because we're the representing band for the state and the namesake ship, we're hoping we can grease the wheels and get in there so the kids get that real world," the band director said. "This is history. It's America. It's Utah.
We have to get those kids down there.
